current.text: He is a rookie. He is about 23 and a half years old. The Kings traded up to pick 29 to draft him.
In Summer League he averaged 8 points on 16.5% usage.
Lloyd thought he looked bad in Summer League. He does not expect him to be a rotation player this season.
Experts rank him below his draft slot.
The projected Kings starters are Acuff, LaVine, Hunter, Murray and Sabonis. Nobody is pushing that group for a starting spot.
Experts disagree on how much the Kings will use rookies. One note says Sacramento will give rookies minutes. Another says coach Doug Christie is under pressure and may lean on veterans to win games.
The Kings are expected to be one of the worst teams in the league. The hosts predict about 26 or 27 wins, and Vegas has them at about 21.5 to 22.5.

durable.text: He used about 17% of his team's possessions in college.
He is a low-usage shooter who does little else. His best case is a Steve Novak type of player. A less kind comparison is a much worse Duncan Robinson.
His game translates poorly to fantasy, so he has little fantasy appeal even if he plays.
